Name: SeasonsOfOrbis
Description: Seasons of Orbis, yearly events for any server running Ziggfreed's CommonLib and RPG Stations. The first is Hallow's Eve: each October, Old Jack opens the Forgotten Temple with a questline, dailies and a nightly board, all paid in Hallow Sweets, and the dead walk at night. Throw Lantern Bombs, and trick-or-treat at every character with a conversation. RPG Stations runs the Carving Bench; MMO Skill Tree is optional and adds skill XP and set bonuses.
